scope: P17 independent source challenges and controlled tests; no production edits, formal app actions or user-data reads.

findings.problem: Non-ready prepare reply was published before stage validation, including false completed status without a start call.
findings.greenResult: Author ran 14/14 including independent 3; reviewer read original log; production stage validation now precedes publication.

findings.problem: Never-settled no-IO prepare trapped UI in preparing without dismissal or exit recovery.
findings.redResult: 2 failures and 3 passes, exit 1. Late-ready test originally failed at inability to dismiss before exercising later cancel.
findings.greenResult: Author ran 18/18 including independent tests after adding settled field and withdrawn-prepare cleanup; final late cleanup/exit integration still to review.

findings.problem: Canonical destination receipt disagreed with explicit selected alias; growing source could emit progress above verified total.
findings.redResult: Independent 8: 2 failures, 6 passes; run by backend owner.
findings.greenResult: 14/14 including independent 8; owner run, original log inspected.

findings.problem: Actual parent manual reread with pending error emitted an unhandled rejection, gave no error notice and resumed revision checks.
findings.status: Reported to frontend owner; final repair pending.

findings.problem: Cancelled or hidden presentation was treated as no native operation; whole-file reread admitted a second unresolved read.
findings.result: 2/2 effective failures in actual Chromium/StrictMode parent with controlled IPC. Each read count grew from 2 to 3 while first promise remained unresolved.
findings.status: Reported to frontend owner; final repair pending.

findings.problem: Authoritative absence after ready TTL needs an explicit no-current-IO result; generic null/IPC failure must remain unknown.
findings.status: Root requested challenge; DTO being coordinated, no new test run yet.

browserHarnessFailures.classification: Harness clicked retry before the cancelled native promise finally released its slot; 3 checks had passed.
Harness passed a non-existent parent readingPosition prop; actual DOM correctly navigated, but assertion waited on an unused local ref. Replaced with visible DOM assertions, no product change.

sourceBoundary: Seven targeted renderer sources remained identical through the effective red scenarios; later owner fixes are not covered until final rerun.
limitations: Mock IPC tests do not prove native OS scheduling, blocked syscalls or Tauri behavior.
Rust copy publication callbacks deterministically model before/after publication ownership; they are not a simultaneous multithread CAS stress test.
No Windows runtime, hostile same-user last-instruction pathname race or remote-volume durability claim.
Actual 256 MiB benchmark belongs to backend owner evidence and has not yet been independently reviewed here.
Do not treat this checkpoint as a final approval or installation acceptance.
